source_title: 'India progressing with new vision, confidence': PM Modi at science conclave - The Times of India

This transformation can be better understood through a few examples from the past year. Building a 'Viksit Bharat' will require a vast amount of nuclear energy," PM Modi said."India is moving toward developing secure solutions that can reach people on a massive scale. Today, many Indian startups are bringing forth innovative solutions in the field of space science," he added.This comes as PM Modi innaugurated the Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.The three-day Conclave scheduled from 27 to 29 October will bring together leading scientists, researchers, academicians, policymakers, industry leaders, startups and international experts to deliberate on emerging technologies and India's science, technology and innovation priorities.Deliberations will span 12 thematic areas, including artificial intelligence, biotechnology, advanced materials, manufacturing, healthcare, energy, climate and ocean sciences.Get the latest India News and Live updates.
